title: Shopping Cart Management Flow
interaction_flow: Customer → AddtoCart: GET /AddtoCart?pid=&pqty= (HttpSession must have username, password, usertype=customer)
CartServiceImpl → DB: SELECT sum(quantity) FROM usercart WHERE username=? AND prodid=?
alt pQty == cartQty (toggle-off / remove one unit):
AddtoCart → CartServiceImpl: removeProductFromCart(userId, prodId) → String status
CartServiceImpl → DB: SELECT * FROM usercart WHERE username=? AND prodid=?
CartServiceImpl → DB: UPDATE usercart SET quantity=qty-1 (if qty-1>0) OR DELETE FROM usercart (if qty-1<=0)
AddtoCart → Browser: forward userHome.jsp + status message
AddtoCart → Browser: 'Product is Out of Stock!'
CartServiceImpl → DB: SELECT existing row; if exists UPDATE usercart SET quantity=availableQty; else INSERT INTO usercart
AddtoCart → Browser: forward cartDetails.jsp + availability warning
CartServiceImpl → DB: SELECT * usercart; if row exists → UPDATE quantity; if not exists → INSERT
AddtoCart → Browser: forward userHome.jsp + success status
UpdateToCart → Browser: forward cartDetails.jsp + capped-qty warning
Admin → RemoveProductSrv: GET /RemoveProductSrv?prodid= (session usertype must be 'admin')
key_relationships: AddtoCart extends HttpServlet, depends_on CartServiceImpl, ProductServiceImpl, DemandServiceImpl
UpdateToCart extends HttpServlet, depends_on CartServiceImpl, ProductServiceImpl, DemandServiceImpl
RemoveProductSrv extends HttpServlet, depends_on ProductServiceImpl (admin product removal only)
CartServiceImpl depends_on ProductServiceImpl (inner call in addProductToCart for stock check)
CartServiceImpl depends_on DemandServiceImpl (demand registration in addProductToCart)
DBUtil uses DriverManager/JDBC to connect to MySQL (application.properties config)
cartserviceimpl_extra_methods: getProductCount(userId, prodId): int  [not in interface, used by AddtoCart]
important_notes: RemoveProductSrv removes a product from the STORE (admin only), not from a user cart — it delegates to ProductServiceImpl.removeProduct(), NOT CartServiceImpl
Actual cart item removal is triggered inside AddtoCart when pQty param == current cartQty (toggle-off behavior)
removeProductFromCart decrements qty by 1; if qty reaches 0 it deletes the row
updateProductToCart does an INSERT if row not found, UPDATE if found and qty>0, DELETE if qty==0
DBUtil.closeConnection(Connection) body is commented out (no-op) — connection is effectively a singleton
DemandServiceImpl.addProduct() records backorder demand and triggers future email notification
Session attributes checked: username, password, usertype (must be 'customer' for AddtoCart)
